newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PPC SAYS HIT BY WEAK CEMENT DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: PPC SAYS HIT BY WEAK CEMENT DEMAND.

text.p: Pretoria Portland Cement Ltd said on Tuesday that first half results had been disappointing and low growth in national demand for cement in the past six months of two percent would impact overall growth in demand for the full year.
But improved margins in the second half should result in earnings per share for the year being maintained.
PPC announced an 11 percent fall in first half earnings per share, confounding analysts who had expected a modest increase.
The company said it was adversely affected by increased costs and a high tax charge, while selling prices had risen by less than inflation.

Domestic cement demand was lower than expected, curbed by continued high interest rates which limited private fixed investment expenditure, PPC said. But the Western Cape -- the fastest growing region in South Africa -- was one bright spot and export volumes had also increased.
